topic: thand mein Mata Parvati ne Mahadev ke Nagdev ko chhupa liya
summary: Kailash Parivar mini: thand mein kaanpte Nagdev ko Mata Parvati ne shawl mein dhak liya; Mahadev dhoondhte hain, Nagdev muskurate gale laut aate hain
moral: Mamta har jeev ko apna maan leti hai
title: Nagdev kahan gaye?

scenes.prompt: A cozy snowy night on Mount Kailash under a starry sky, Mata Parvati sits by a small warm fire wrapped in a soft red shawl, a small friendly blue cobra (Nagdev) curls up shivering near her hands, little Bal Ganesh peeks from behind her, Mahadev sits in calm meditation in the background with eyes closed, warm firelight, medium wide shot
scenes.animate: snowflakes drift slowly, the fire flickers softly and the little cobra shivers, then nestles into the red shawl

lines.tts: अरे, हमारे नागदेव तो ठंड से काँप रहे हैं!
lines.sub: Arey, hamare Nagdev to thand se kaanp rahe hain!

lines.tts: माँ, इन्हें अपनी शॉल में छुपा लो!
lines.sub: Maa, inhe apni shawl mein chhupa lo!

scenes.prompt: Mahadev opens his eyes after meditation on snowy Kailash at night and gently touches his neck, looking around surprised and curious, Mata Parvati beside him hides a smile holding a bundled red shawl, little Bal Ganesh giggles with his hand over his mouth, soft moonlight, medium shot

lines.tts: पार्वती, मेरे नागदेव कहाँ चले गए?
lines.sub: Parvati, mere Nagdev kahan chale gaye?

lines.tts: पिताजी, वो तो माँ की गोद में सो रहे हैं!
lines.sub: Pitaji, wo to maa ki god mein so rahe hain!

scenes.prompt: Mata Parvati gently opens the red shawl and the small friendly blue cobra peeks out warm and happy, then glides back to curl around Mahadev's neck, Mahadev smiles warmly at Parvati, Bal Ganesh claps happily, snowy Kailash at night with soft golden light, medium shot
scenes.animate: the little cobra slowly peeks out of the shawl and glides back around Mahadev's neck, Mahadev smiles gently

lines.tts: ठंड में काँप रहे थे, तो माँ की तरह ढक लिया।
lines.sub: Thand mein kaanp rahe the, to maa ki tarah dhak liya.

lines.tts: तुम्हारी ममता से तो मेरे नागदेव भी नहीं बच पाए।
lines.sub: Tumhari mamta se to mere Nagdev bhi nahi bach paaye.

endcard.tts: ममता हर जीव को अपना मान लेती है। अच्छा लगे तो लाइक और सब्सक्राइब करें।
endcard.sub: Mamta har jeev ko apna maan leti hai. Achha lage to Like aur Subscribe karein.
